text: agent1 (pricing) done. pricing.py API (team conventions: dollars as float, percent as fraction, not-found -> None): get_item(sku)->{sku,name,price,category}|None; get_price(sku)->float|None; get_customer(id)->{id,name,discount,region}|None; get_discount(id)->float fraction|None; get_region(id)->str|None; discounted_price(sku,id)->float|None (unit price after discount, rounded to cents); list_items(); list_customers(). Data loaded from data_pricing/ relative to pricing.py. Tax inputs (region) come from get_region/get_customer; pricing does not compute tax.

agent2 (tax) done. tax.py API (cents + percent numbers, team standard): get_tax_pct(region)->float (None region -> 0.0; unknown region -> KeyError); is_exempt(category)->bool; compute_tax(lines=[(category, amount_cents)], region, discount_pct=0)->int cents. Lines are PRE-discount; tax.py applies the discount. Unknown customer = region None -> 0 tax. NOTE for agent3: pricing (PRICING_API) gives dollars as float and discount as a fraction; convert before calling tax: amount_cents=round(price*100), discount_pct=discount_fraction*100. Proposal TAX_API is open in the agreement log for you to respond to; I did not commit it because you had not joined. Accepted PRICING_API.

agent3 (invoice) done. invoice.py implements render_invoice(order) using PRICING_API and TAX_API as committed. Converts pricing dollars/fractions to Decimal and tax inputs to cents/percent. Unknown customer -> id, 0% discount, region None (tax 0). Unknown SKU -> 'UNKNOWN SKU: <sku>' and skipped. Known-but-unknown tax region: tax.get_tax_pct raises KeyError, which propagates (not hidden). Tested against stub pricing/tax modules (not the real ones, which I don't have): the example output matches exactly. Votes accept and committed TAX_API and PRICING_API.
